convention: levels (v1, v2, v3, s1, s2); 6Y = 3 n2 - 2 n3; T3 = +1/2 on s1, -1/2 on s2; Q = n_s1 - n3/3; left = even occupation; conjugate = complement

A_charges_that_survive_the_one_family_id.odd_condition: q = a + sum_j b_j n_j is odd under the complement iff a = -(1/2) sum_j b_j: the space is spanned by the five centred level numbers n_j - 1/2
identities: X = 2 n - 5 = -5 (B - L) + 4 Y on all 32 patterns
B - L = 1 - (2/3) n3 = N - (2/5) n + (4/5) Y per quantum
A_charges_that_survive_the_one_family_id.statement: The diagonal charges that descend to one family (complements as holes) are the five centred level numbers. Four of them are gauge Cartans (two of colour, T3, Y); the fifth independent one is B - L. The native degree n and the number of quanta N are even under the complement and do not descend separately; their odd combination X = 2 n - 5 N does, and X = -5 (B - L) + 4 Y.

commutes_with: the toggle a_s2 + a*_s2 (mass option M2)
untouched_by_construction: routing S_fwd, S_rev (the pattern is a passive label)
mass options M0, M1, M3 (record and carrier sector only)
B_B_minus_L_against_the_operators_of_the.statement: Every operator of the source on the patterns commutes with B - L = 1 - (2/3) n3. Among the ten colour- and charge-conserving mass links the eight toggles carry B - L = 0; the singlet link (top form) and the doublet link carry B - L = +-2. Among the 45 bilinears of the level operators the ones that change B - L move vector levels (a_v a_v: 4/3, a_v a_s: 2/3, a*_v a_s: -2/3) and none of them conserves colour and charge.

C_conserved_combinations_of_the_native_n.unknown: q = alpha N + beta n on each left field, h on the Higgs doublet (its conjugate carries -h)

four_Dirac_channels.reading: one combination survives: (alpha, beta, h) = (-5/2, 1, 1), that is X/2 = n - (5/2) N with the Higgs carrying 1; per left field X/2 = -(5/2)(B - L) + 2 Y. N and n separately are broken.

four_Dirac_channels_and_the_singlet_pair.reading: nothing survives: the pairing breaks X (B - L) by 10 (2)

C_conserved_combinations_of_the_native_n.statement: A Dirac sector with one Higgs doublet breaks the number of quanta and the native degree separately and keeps exactly their odd combination, which is B - L up to hypercharge. The singlet pairing is the one mass term that breaks it. No gauge current distinguishes the two cases.

D_anomalies_of_B_minus_L.statement: B - L is free of every anomaly on the full even module of sixteen states and has gravitational and cubic anomaly -1 per family on the fifteen-state module.

E_class_zero.statement: Class 0 is its own conjugate, so the Z6 label never forbids a self-pairing. Among the left class-0 fields only N^c = 00000 carries no gauge charge (e^c = 00011 is class 0 with Q = +1); its self-pairing is limited by B - L alone.
